subject: general
question: The list of states and union territories is mentioned in the __________ schedule of the Constitution of India.
solution:
The correct answer is **__First__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The list of states and union territories is mentioned in the first schedule of the Constitution of India.**
 
• **First Schedule of the constitution states:**
 
 
• **Names of the States** and their territorial jurisdiction.
 
• **Names of the Union Territories** and their extent.
 
 
 
• **Schedule 1 consists of Article 1 to Article 4.**
 
• **Article 1 **- India, Bharat is the union of States.
 
• **Article 2** - Admission of States.
 
• **Article 3** - Creation of new States, alternation of boundaries.
 
• **Article 4 **- Abolition of State.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Originally **there are **EIGHT schedules**, at present, there are **TWELVE schedules**. 
 
• **Schedule 2 **- Allowances of President, Vice president, Judges of Supreme and High Courts, Speaker of Lok Sabha, etc.
 
• **Schedule 3 - Oath and Affirmation **
 
• **Schedule 4 **- Allocation of Seats in Rajya Sabha to States and Union Territories.
 
• **Schedule 5** - Provision and Administration of Schedule Area.
 
• **Schedule 6 **- Provision and Administration of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, Mizoram.
 
• **Schedule 7- Division of Powers.**
 
• **Schedule 8 **- Languages.
 
• **Schedule 9** - Acts and Regulation
 
• **Schedule 10 - Anti Defection Act**
 
• **Schedule 11 - Panchayat**
 
• **Schedule 12 **- **Municipality**
